reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unnecessary edit was introduced.

Cited text supports compliance: Section 2(a) expressly states Client is not obligated to use the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize competing software/services, subject only to TrueLink's IP rights and the Section 10 confidentiality obligation — ordinary carve-outs rather than business restrictions, so the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is met.

The rationale correctly declines to flag the Section 8(d) reference to a separate 'Non-Competition Agreement' because it operates as a limitation on TrueLink's use of Credit Data (i.e., in our favour), while appropriately noting that the separate agreement is not before us and warrants independent review.

The licence-scope language ('ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables') is correctly characterised as defining permitted use of TrueLink's Interface, not a covenant restricting Client's own activities; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
